column1: Complete or review the results from 75 on-site supplier audits to drive reduction in priority and major findings, and faster time to closure.
Enable 100 of our top Tier 1  suppliers to meet our PASS program requirements by the end of 2014, and all 250 top Tier 1 suppliers to meet the requirements by the end of 2016.
Establish a 100% “green” Intel ground transportation fleet by 2016.
Reach at least one-third of our top Tier 1 suppliers through our capacity-building programs by the end of 2014.
Complete a third-party audit of one of our assembly and test facilities in 2014.
